snippet.title: MechWarrior 5: Clans - Ghost Bear: Flash Storm - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Storm Breaks May 8th Midnight UTC. (May 7th 5 PM PDT / 8 PM EDT) 

https://mw5clans.com/purchase

Clan Ghost Bear enters the Clan Invasion to prove their strength and reclaim lost glory. Command Silveroot Keshik, fight legendary foes, and claim powerful OmniMechs. Command Elementals, battle in space, and take on new bosses. Expanded MechLab customization and new Clan BattleMechs await!
